senses.gloss: customary additional weight in retailing, boot, v. גֵּירוּמִים.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 5a:84">Ker. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>בה׳ הוא שוקל וכ׳</he> must he weigh (the frank incense) with boot or exactly (v. <cite ref="P00601"><he>עַיִן</he></cite>)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 102a:1">Snh. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>אחד מכ״ד בה׳ ליטרא</he> one twenty fourth of the overweight of a litra (a minute portion).

senses.gloss: (Gramm.) decision as to the junction of a word with the preceding or the following word (v. next w.), construction, syntax.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 52a:8">Yoma 52ᵃ</cite> in five verses <he>אין להם ה׳</he> the grammatical construction is undecided; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80:5">Gen. R. s. 80</cite>; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 26">B’shall. 26</cite>; Mekh. B’shall., Amalek 1; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="E00523"><he>הֶכְרֵיעִים</he></cite>. Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Nehemiah 8:8">Neh. VIII, 8</cite> <he>ויבינו</he>) <he>אלו הה׳</he> that means the grammatical constructions.
